body:
Escalated to effort:high before claiming or changing code.

The scope needs new behavior across camcraft-app and camcraft-ui. History has no begin_group or commit_group. The app MCP layer cannot read UI geometry picks directly. It needs a selection snapshot passed from the UI to preserve ui -> app dependencies.

On upstream/main 780b0a25, answer_live dispatches tools without an approval check except for its existing open_project refusal. The chat panel added by #2094 has a worker-side confirmation handshake, but that does not enforce approval at live dispatch. This work introduces a new safety refusal for posting and machine limits. The effort table places multi-crate behavior and refusal laws at effort:high.

The work-issue escalation rule requires stopping when work exceeds its effort label. No code, tests, branch, worktree, or PR was created. No claim was taken. The issue remains free for a high-tier worker.
